visualCharacteristics.layout: 2-up grid on tablet/desktop, stacked on mobile; image on top, body below, full-width CTA button at the bottom
visualCharacteristics.notes: used in grey and dark sections

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: image (optionally linked); cell 2: optional eyebrow paragraph, linked heading, text paragraph, CTA link (bold = primary button)

usage: 'Andere Besucher haben sich angesehen' and 'Unsere Erfolge' teaser pairs on the homepage.
reuseGuidance: Use for two or more static promotional teasers. Use carousel-teaser when items should scroll.
